title: Client software capstone with an AI Knowledge Assistant
summary: Final-year students work in 19 teams on semester-long software projects for real clients using an agile initial phase and three monthly sprints. An AI Knowledge Assistant embedded in the Kanban platform answers project and assignment questions; teams submit sprint deliverables, documentation, and a functional product for client approval.

sources.title: Toward an AI Knowledge Assistant for Context-Aware Learning Experiences in Software Capstone Project Development
sources.evidence_quote: During a semester-long capstone course, 200 students were organized among 19 project groups, each charged with working on tangible software development projects with real clients.

purpose_and_stakes.pass_requirement: Outright client disapproval of the proposed solution fails the course.

assessment.summary: Develop a software solution for a real client through three agile sprints with an embedded context-aware AI assistant.
student_actions: Work in a project team with a real client.
Plan and deliver a functional product increment each sprint.
Query the AI Knowledge Assistant for project support.
Present deliverables for staff and client assessment.

student_role.description: Students query an assistant grounded in course lessons, prior projects, and Stack Overflow.

grading.method: Staff assess process and product after each sprint with phase-dependent weights; clients approve or reject the final solution.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
